items.source: Registers the given RepositoryConfigurationExtension to indicate the repository configuration for a particular store (expressed through the extension's concrete type) has happened.
items.translation: 注册给定的 RepositoryConfigurationExtension，以表明针对特定存储（通过扩展的具体类型表达）的仓库配置已完成。

items.source: Registers the given RepositoryConfigurationExtension to indicate the repository configuration for a particular store (expressed through the extension's concrete type) has happened. Useful for downstream components that need to detect exactly that case. The bean definition is marked as lazy-init so that it doesn't get instantiated if no one really cares.
items.translation: 注册给定的 RepositoryConfigurationExtension，以表明针对特定存储（通过扩展的具体类型表达）的仓库配置已完成。这对于需要精确检测该情况的下游组件非常有用。该 Bean 定义被标记为懒加载（lazy-init），因此如果没有人真正关心它，则不会进行实例化。

items.source:
Helper class to centralize common functionality that needs to be used in various places of the configuration
implementation.
items.translation: 辅助类，用于集中管理在配置实现中多个位置需要使用的通用功能。
